[[Saevio Proelium]] is a [[Titan]] that was captured by the [[Order of Whispers]] a century before [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]] and interrogated. He was later [[Saevio Proelium's Tomb|imprisoned]] near the [[Monument to the Defeat of Palawa Joko]], but was freed by [[Margonite]]s and escaped to the [[Domain of Pain]].
